What share of each Amsterdam analysis window is in a mapped road-noise class of at least 70 dB Lden?

Rank these workflows for the question as written.
A. Proportion(Coverage(Constrain(noise), zone))  [Constrain: >= 70 dB]
B. Proportion(Coverage(noise, zone))
C. Proportion(Coverage(Constrain(Clip(noise, zone)), zone))  [Constrain: >= 70 dB]
D. Proportion(Coverage(Constrain(noise), zone))  [Constrain: >= 75 dB]

Enter JSON rank groups, best first. For example [["W"], ["X", "Y"], ["Z"]].
Put tied candidates in the same group and use each label exactly once.
